purpose: First quantitative measurement of the size of the MA-1 equidistribution deviation (paper 132 residual gap item 3): effectivize Model Assumption MA-1 (pair-equidistribution of primes among reduced residue classes) at practical sizes, and measure how much the 4/3 speedup cap 1/(1-theta+theta^2) moves when theta is adjusted by measured deviations.

hypotheses_stated_before_data.H1: The maximum per-class deviation |pi(x;m,a) - x/(phi(m)*m')|/x for m <= 100 at x = 2^40 is < 0.001 -- small enough that the 4/3 cap's constants hold to three significant figures at cryptographic sizes.
hypotheses_stated_before_data.H2: The deviation is dominated by a single class (the 'Siegel zero analogue') rather than spread evenly.
hypotheses_stated_before_data.H3: The deviation shrinks as x grows from 2^30 to 2^50 (computing exact prime counts in arithmetic progressions at these sizes via Meissel-Lehmer or similar).

design.pair_addition_note: PRE-REGISTERED ADDITION (before data): every added modulus divides lcm(3,4,5,7,8,11,31)=286440, so per-class counts come free in the same single sieve pass. Added so the 'PAIR-equidistribution' reading of MA-1 (joint classes for prime pairs via CRT) is measured directly, not only single-modulus marginals.
design.x_checkpoints: 2^24 through 2^40 every power of two (includes the mandated 2^30, 2^35, 2^40); richer trend grid for H3 at zero extra cost. 2^50 dropped from plan: exact sieve to 2^50 exceeds the 25-min budget; the 2^24..2^40 grid spans a factor 65536 in x, ample for a shrinkage-exponent fit.
design.method: Single segmented sieve (C, OpenMP, odd-only byte segments of 2^24) to 2^40; every surviving prime increments counter[p mod 286440]; per-(m,class) counts aggregated at each checkpoint. Exact enumeration, no randomness, seed irrelevant.
design.main_term_note: The design's main term 'x/(phi(m)*m')' has ambiguous m'. PRE-REGISTERED INTERPRETATION: primary main term Li(x)/phi(m) (PNT-AP), secondary x/(phi(m)*ln x). Both are reported; the 0.001-scale H1 verdict and the cap-shift conclusion are checked to be invariant to this choice (cap shift depends on deviation SQUARED).

cap_correction_definition.base: cap(theta) = 1/(1 - theta + theta^2); theta = 1/2 reproduces the 4/3 cap exactly (vertex/minimum of the parabola).
cap_correction_definition.adjustment: theta_eff = 1/2 + delta, delta = worst measured per-class relative deviation of pi(x;m,a) from its main term at x = 2^40; cap_eff = 1/(3/4 + delta^2).

barriers_preregistered: (5)/(8): standard lines, no contact expected -- this is exact enumeration, no factoring route claimed. Role: THEORY-SUPPORT for paper 132's barrier-4 converse (residual gap item 3: effectivizing MA-1).
